paragraphs.text:
The creature trembles under the impact of the bullet! However, 
you see no trace of a wound. Perhaps you were rash to believe 
that an entity whose touch annihilates matter could be harmed 
by a lead projectile. Nonetheless, you seem to have startled it, 
and it rolls away into the woods.
